description: Deterministic local coding-agent baseline across JavaScript utilities, input handling, asynchronous control flow, HTTP header semantics, and a multi-file module integration task. Fixtures begin with failing assertions; passing means exact patch paths and candidate verification.

tasks.title: Implement a bounded numeric clamp helper
tasks.goal: Implement and export clamp(value, min, max) in src/math.mjs. Return min when value is below the range, max when it is above, and the original value when inside the inclusive range. Assume finite numeric arguments and min <= max. Do not mutate inputs. Do not edit tests or package files.

tasks.title: Normalize strings into URL-safe slugs
tasks.goal: Fix and export slugify(value) in src/strings.mjs. Preserve the existing null/undefined to empty-string behavior. Lowercase the string, replace every run of non-ASCII-alphanumeric characters with one hyphen, and trim hyphens from both ends. Do not edit tests or package files.

tasks.title: Merge nested configuration objects safely
tasks.goal: Fix mergeConfig(base, override) in src/config.mjs. Recursively merge nested plain objects, preserve base keys not present in override, and replace arrays rather than merging their elements. Neither input object may be mutated. Keep the exported function name and do not edit tests or package files.

tasks.title: Validate positive safe integers
tasks.goal: Implement and export parsePositiveInteger(value) in src/validation.mjs. Accept a number or a non-empty numeric string only when its parsed value is a positive safe integer. Return the integer value when valid and null for zero, negative, fractional, non-finite, unsafe, empty, or unsupported input. Do not mutate input or edit tests.

tasks.title: Split arrays into fixed-size chunks
tasks.goal: Implement and export chunkArray(values, size) in src/array.mjs. Return ordered consecutive chunks with no chunk larger than size. Preserve the original values. Return an empty array for non-arrays and sizes that are not positive safe integers. Do not mutate inputs or edit tests.

tasks.title: Implement case-insensitive safe HTTP header lookup
tasks.goal: Implement getHeader(headers, name) in src/headers.mjs. Look up HTTP header names case-insensitively without mutating the supplied object. Accept only a non-empty string name and a plain object or null-prototype object. Return undefined for invalid inputs, missing names, and inherited properties. Preserve the original header value. Do not edit tests or package files.

tasks.title: Implement bounded asynchronous retry with selective retry policy
tasks.goal: Implement and export async retry(operation, options={}) in src/retry.mjs. operation must be a function. Support maxAttempts (default 3, positive safe integer), shouldRetry(error, attempt) (default true), and delayMs (default 0, finite non-negative number). Call operation with a 1-based attempt number, return the first successful result, immediately rethrow when shouldRetry returns false, and throw the final error after maxAttempts. Use Promise-based delay without blocking the event loop. Do not edit tests or package files.

tasks.title: Implement and export a reusable in-memory cache across modules
tasks.goal: Implement createCache() in src/cache.mjs and export it from src/index.mjs. The returned cache must use Map semantics and expose set(key,value) returning the cache, get(key), has(key), delete(key), clear(), and a read-only size getter. Preserve arbitrary key identity and values including undefined. Do not edit tests or package files.
